**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:20](CHANGELOG.md:20).** Of 380 commits, 12 matter.

Three breaking. The v1 export route is gone. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. Expired tokens now return 401, not 403.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff.

Eight fixes. The big one: request bodies stopped going to the logs.

Next: check the date, I guessed `2026-08-30`. Perf work had no numbers so I left it out. `docs: note the minimum node version` may hide a Node floor bump.
